ModMetaData.name: Azrael
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
Series showcase package for the Azrael RimWorld mods.
THE DEEP HOMESTEAD (scenario) - Three settlers, farm kit, mountain-foothills fantasy. - Forces the Azrael storyteller. - Soft start parts when Homesteader / Strata are loaded (MayRequire).
AZRAEL (storyteller) - Canonical copy ships with Homesteader. - This mod injects the same storyteller only if Homesteader is not loaded (no duplicate defs when both are active). - Cassandra-style pacing with slightly more Misc and ThreatSmall pressure.
REQUIRES - Harmony. RimWorld 1.6.
RECOMMENDED (soft) - Homesteader (owns the storyteller), Strata, Stormproof, Living World, Nemesis, Deep Colony.
Safe to add mid-save for the storyteller alone; start a new game for the scenario.
